gateCatalog.core-prechecks-passed: VCF core upgrade prechecks, credentials, certificates, DNS and depot access are healthy.
gateCatalog.hardware-compatible-9.1: All server, storage and network devices are present in the pinned target compatibility set.
gateCatalog.stretched-vsan-healthy: Both data fault domains and the independent witness have healthy vSAN objects and connectivity.
gateCatalog.operations-9.1-ready: VCF Operations has completed its 9.1 transition and is ready to host target lifecycle services.
gateCatalog.sddc-manager-9.1-ready: SDDC Manager is at 9.1 and its inventory is healthy.
gateCatalog.management-services-9.1-ready: The VCF Management Services cluster is deployed and reachable.
gateCatalog.license-server-9.1-ready: The mandatory centralized VCF License Server is deployed with forward and reverse DNS and is reachable from VCF Operations.
gateCatalog.nsx-management-9.1-ready: The NSX management plane is at the target version and reports a healthy fabric.
gateCatalog.vcenter-9.1-ready: The management vCenter is at the target version and connected to NSX and SDDC Manager.
gateCatalog.witness-9.1-ready: The dedicated third-site witness is at the target ESX version and vSAN health is green.
gateCatalog.data-hosts-9.1-ready: Every management-domain data host at both sites is at the target ESX version.
gateCatalog.nsx-edges-9.1-finalized: Both NSX Edge nodes are upgraded and NSX finalization has completed.
